section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section summarizes an investigation into the role of Executive Functions (EFs) in creativity. The study examined how Updating, Shifting, and Inhibition predict creativity, which was operationalized in three ways: divergent thinking performance, self-reported creative achievements (arts and science), and involvement in artistic professions. Results indicated that the role of EFs varied depending on the creativity measure, with Updating predicting divergent thinking, Inhibition predicting artistic achievements, and overall EF and Shifting predicting involvement in artistic professions.
